info.name: Large File Previews
info.summary: Previews of PDFs, Illustrator files and images too large for Nextcloud's own preview providers
info.description:
Renders previews of files too large for Nextcloud's own preview providers, by handing the file where it lies to a command-line renderer rather than loading it into PHP or sending it to a service.
What you get:
- **PDF and Illustrator previews** through `pdftoppm` (poppler), of the first page, at the full preview size, or a scanned page at its own resolution where that is smaller, for files of any size. - **Image previews** through `vipsthumbnail` (libvips): TIFF, JPEG, PNG, WebP, GIF, HEIC, HEIF and AVIF, each type off until it is switched on, read in strips or from a pyramid's nearest level; a TIFF in one large strip that runs out of memory gets a second chance through `tiffcp`. - **Limits around every render**: a timeout, address-space and file-size caps and a raised out-of-memory score, each with its value, the two caps switched together. - **Per type and per extension**: which files the app takes, and from which size up to which size; anything it declines goes to the next provider.
Only files on local, unencrypted storage are rendered. Everything else is left to Nextcloud's other preview providers.
info.author: metaworx resonare rüegg
